R2 (2026-10-08) REPLACES the R1 description of this task (R1 text retained in git history and in the superseded plan). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-08-163f-r2-step-0c-evidence-on-192f-record-plan.md, unit U3. Edit BOTH templates/skills/shipment-reconcile/SKILL.md.tmpl and .github/skills/shipment-reconcile/SKILL.md (identical apart from placeholders; anchors re-grounded 2026-10-08, locate by quoted text):
1. Step 0(c): ONE sentence stating the `autoharness shipment cascade-close --classify-only` pre_close record is the Step 0(c) pre-mutation evidence record and closure-evidence rejects it when it is not provably pre-mutation. Do not restate the "before the cascade" requirement again (R1 H-1).
2. Promote the "Pre-Mode step 2b agreement check" paragraph (~L757-L779, just before `<!-- cascade-close-routing:BEGIN step-0c -->`) to a labelled Step 0(d); add `pre_report_path` to `## Inputs` (safe-close only; optional; REQUIRED when a pre-close Pre-Mode run returned a report within this lock hold); compare exactly that path; restate not-applicable as "`pre_report_path` absent"; present-but-unreadable = difference -> RECONCILE_FAIL_PREMODE_CLASSIFIER_DRIFT.
3. Replace "(Ship Step 5)" (~L776) with "(Ship's post-merge closure)" in both copies (E1E31E6A part 1).
4. Deterministic Safe-Close Scenario Matrix + Quality Criteria: rows for the closure-evidence ordering rejection and for pre_report_path absent / present-agreeing / present-differing.
No change to the routing table, Pre-Mode member-class contract, or Safe-Close steps 1-10.

Acceptance: 163.003-T guard passes; parity holds. Gate: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests.
Stash traceability: D6502107, E1E31E6A, A9BABC8B, 856B6770.
